units.source_text: 太吉郎店铺的生意日渐萧条，由一个同行，且是区区年轻人来帮忙，实在有失体面。

en.t: Taikichiro's shop was growing more desolate by the day, and to have someone in the same trade, a mere young man at that, come to help was truly a loss of face.

units.source_text: 要说是去学习，从两家商店的规模看来，应该是倒过来。

en.t: If anyone were going to learn from the other, judging by the scale of the two shops, it ought to have been the other way around.
